caption:
A verse to read before every message you type

Allah tells the believers to be mindful of Him and say what is right, and promises to set their deeds right and forgive their sins. Read your words once more before they leave your hands.

Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:70-71

Which message will you rewrite before sending it today?

#speakthetruth #honestwords #muslimmanners #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais
alt_text: O you who believe, fear Allah and say what is right. He will guide you to righteous deeds and forgive your sins. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger will surely achieve a supreme triumph (Surah Al-Ahzaab 33:70-71)
